nodes.label: Core Web Vitals
nodes.rationale: LCP, INP and CLS provide user-facing load, interaction and visual stability measures; real devices and networks are necessary evidence.

nodes.label: Artifact Drift Maintenance

nodes.label: Normative Design Tokens
nodes.rationale: DESIGN.md frontmatter owns observed token primitives; prose explains their application without inventing or duplicating values.

nodes.label: Existing Page Reuse

nodes.label: Resilient Interface States
nodes.rationale: Real inputs, errors, languages, interrupted gestures, and network conditions must preserve task completion and recovery.

nodes.label: Durable Product Truth
nodes.rationale: PRODUCT.md records confirmed users, purpose, capabilities, constraints and brand commitments; visual worlds and surface strategy belong elsewhere.

nodes.label: Apple Platform Conventions
nodes.rationale: Platform navigation, Dynamic Type, semantic colors, system controls and minimum 44 by 44 point targets keep native apps trustworthy.

nodes.label: Spatial Thesis
nodes.rationale: Reading order, proximity, rhythm, density and structural adaptation express task priority before decoration.

nodes.label: Identity Preserving Variation
nodes.rationale: Default variants vary hierarchy, topology, typography, color, density or decomposition within the existing brand; departure requires explicit redesign intent.
nodes.source_location: ### 4. Plan three variants: identity first, then mode, then axes

nodes.label: Development Only CSP Allowance
nodes.rationale: Local helper allowances belong only in development; production CSP must not be weakened to load the localhost picker.

nodes.label: Familiar Working Product
nodes.rationale: The visual world contributes type, palette, density and one signature move while familiar navigation, layout and controls serve the task.

nodes.label: World Structured Surface
nodes.rationale: Persuade makes the offer and working action clear; Experience leads with the work, and both allow a committed visual world to carry the page.

nodes.label: Calm Reading Column
nodes.rationale: The world owns the masthead, navigation and frame while comprehension, standard wayfinding and a calm reading column remain intact.

nodes.label: Direction Contract
nodes.rationale: A development-only surface brief records thesis, visual world, story, first viewport, selected form and finish condition before code.

nodes.label: Time to First Value
nodes.rationale: Guide users toward a real first success with progressive, contextual help and respect skips and previous dismissals.

nodes.label: Earned Familiarity
nodes.rationale: Task surfaces need consistent familiar controls, complete states and functional motion so the tool disappears into the work.

nodes.label: Measured Bottleneck Removal
nodes.rationale: Measure actual performance before and after changes, preserve accessibility and functionality, and address the biggest bottleneck first.

nodes.label: Scope Preserving Refinement
nodes.rationale: Preserve the incumbent world and behavior; fix blocked tasks, incomplete states, hierarchy and consistency at the narrowest responsible layer.

nodes.label: Restrained Personality
nodes.rationale: Reduce saturation, visual noise and decorative motion while preserving hierarchy, affordances and distinctive character.

nodes.label: Independent Visual Regions
nodes.rationale: Split content, moving parts and surrounding structure into independently identified regions so crops and approval boundaries remain honest.
